title: Metabolomic Analysis of Lytic KSHV Infection: Induced Host Nucleotide Metabolism Is Required for Infectious Virus Production.
snippet: Kaposi's Sarcoma Herpesvirus (KSHV) is the etiological agent of Kaposi's Sarcoma (KS), which induces metabolic stress in infected host cells. KSHV reprograms host metabolic pathways for efficient viral replication and infectious virion production.
